# Interesting Engineering

> > Interesting Engineering showcases groundbreaking innovations, sustainable technologies, and unconventional engineering projects from around the world.

The site covers cutting-edge developments in renewable energy, extreme architecture, transportation, robotics, and consumer technology. Featured projects range from the Shimao Intercontinental Hotel in Shanghai's Songjiang District to piezoelectric energy harvesting and innovative helicopter designs.

## Key Topics

- Renewable Energy
- Sustainable Design
- Extreme Architecture
- Underground Construction
- Underwater Architecture
- Helicopter Innovation
- 3D Printing
- Piezoelectric Energy
- Tidal Power
- Quarry Architecture
- Gaming Technology
- Indoor Navigation
- Urban Transportation
- Safety Innovation
- Shanghai Construction

## Renewable Energy & Sustainable Technology

- [The first man made tidal lagoon could provide power for 155,000 homes](https://interestingengineering.com/culture/the-first-man-made-tidal-lagoon-could-provide-power-for-155000-homes): Tidal Lagoon Swansea Bay project to power 155,000 UK homes
- [New resource of piezoelectric energy discovered](https://interestingengineering.com/innovation/new-resource-of-piezoelectric-energy-discovered): National Physical Laboratory advances piezoelectric energy harvesting tech
- [Unused London Underground lines could become bike paths](https://interestingengineering.com/culture/unused-london-underground-lines-bike-paths): Gensler proposes London Underline cycling paths in abandoned tube tunnels

## Extreme Architecture & Hospitality

- [Construction of an Incredible Underground Hotel in Songjiang Begins](https://interestingengineering.com/culture/construction-of-an-incredible-underground-hotel-in-songjiang-begins): Atkins-designed Shimao Intercontinental Hotel in Shanghai quarry begins
- [Dine in luxury and beauty at the Conrad Maldives Ithaa underwater restaurant](https://interestingengineering.com/culture/dine-in-luxury-and-beauty-at-the-conrad-maldives-ithaa-underwater-hotel): World's first underwater restaurant Ithaa at Conrad Maldives Rangali Island
- [Hanging hotel for rock climbers](https://interestingengineering.com/culture/hanging-hotel-for-rock-climbers): Dr Margot Krasojevic designs suspended hotel concept for rock climbers

## Transportation & Mobility Innovation

- [New Principle of Helicopter Operations Invented in Belgium](https://interestingengineering.com/innovation/new-principle-of-helicopter-vehicle-invented-in-belgium): Belgian startup Sagita unveils Sherpa helicopter with unique propulsion
- [Brazil to Present Monorail for 2014 Football World Cup](https://interestingengineering.com/transportation/brazil-to-introduce-monorail-for-2014-football-world-cup): Sao Paulo Silver Line monorail project for 2014 World Cup
- [Project Titan: The custom military look truck with attitude](https://interestingengineering.com/transportation/project-titan-the-custom-military-look-truck-with-attitude): Nissan Project Titan custom military-style truck for Wounded Warriors
- [Dryve is a portable rain shield for your bicycle](https://interestingengineering.com/culture/dryve-is-a-portable-rain-shield-for-your-bicycle): Swiss company Allnew unveils Dryve portable bicycle rain shield

## Advanced Manufacturing & 3D Printing

- [New Robocop suit was 3D printed](https://interestingengineering.com/innovation/new-robocop-suit-was-3d-printed): Legacy Effects 3D prints Robocop movie costume using advanced tech
- [Inflatable car seat from Volvo could be child safety for 21st century](https://interestingengineering.com/innovation/inflatable-car-seat-from-volvo-could-be-child-safety-for-21st-century): Volvo develops portable inflatable child car seat concept
- [Navigate stores and libraries by barcode](https://interestingengineering.com/innovation/navigate-stores-and-libraries-by-barcode): Swansea University researchers develop barcode-based indoor navigation app

## Consumer Electronics & Gadgets

- [Sony KW1 quirky camera that masquerades as a perfume bottle](https://interestingengineering.com/innovation/sony-kw1-quirky-camera-that-masquerades-as-a-perfume-bottle): Sony Cybershot KW1 perfume bottle-styled selfie camera for women
- [Spy the neighborhood with Spy Hawk](https://interestingengineering.com/innovation/spy-the-neighborhood-with-spy-hawk): Spy Hawk FPV RC aircraft with aerial camera by Hubsan and Fat Shark
- [Even More Realistic Video Gaming](https://interestingengineering.com/culture/even-more-realistic-video-gaming): ARAIG haptic feedback gaming vest for immersive gameplay experience

## Creative Design & Art Projects

- [Metropolis Designs Created Completely by Computer Parts](https://interestingengineering.com/culture/metropolis-designs-created-completely-by-computer-parts): Franco Recchia creates model cities from recycled computer parts
- [Fun furniture for tech and video game fans](https://interestingengineering.com/culture/fun-furniture-for-tech-and-video-game-fans): Gaming-inspired furniture including PacMan and Scrabble themed pieces
- [Flying drones could be the bartenders in the home of the future](https://interestingengineering.com/culture/flying-drones-are-personal-bartenders-of-the-future-for-the-home): Herman Haydin's Yura flying drone bartender concept for Electrolux
